title.narrative: Food security and livelihood support for IDPs and vulunerable communities in Abukarshola

description.narrative: As the result of the on going conflict in south Kordfan the targeted communities in Abu Karshola locality are unable to maintain secure livelihoods because of the disruption of traditional livelihoods patterns, asset loss, disruption of social services, collapse of social networks, lack of access to economic opportunities, and limited access to land. Due to the poor harvest in 2016 season, most of the farmers received lean harvest which has increased of number of acute food insecure households in the targets area. Poor harvest also led to limited agriculture labor opportunities and below average wage rate. The project specific objective: - To reduce food insecurity and malnutrition for 500 Households in Kor Aldalep, Kor Alteena and Alfeed villages in Abu Kershola Locality of South Kordofan. - To strengthen self- reliance and facilitate durable solutions to 500 HH in Kor Aldalep, Kor Alteena and Alfeed villages in Abu Kershola Locality of South Kordofan. Project Outputs: Output 1: 500 framer provided with emergency agricultural inputs seed and tools to IDPs in Abu Kershola Locality of South Kordofan and emergency agricultural extension services to improve production in Abu Kershola Locality of South Kordofan out put 2: 5000 animals belonging to 200 HH provided with vaccination and treatment Output 3: Provide livelihood support to Abu Kershola Locality of South Kordofan Output 4: Build the resilience of community through DRR capacity Project Activities include: 1- Needs assessments and community set -ups, start-up of project 2- Seeds and tools distribution 3- Farmer Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) training based on activities. 4- Training of 6 CAHWs and conduct 2 vaccination campaign. 5-Mobilization and DRR training- HVCA. 6- Development of CAPs and Support to Implement the developed CAPs
